name: manual_f2913a
claim: When fixing a Dependabot alert by bumping to its first_patched_version, check the package's own recent release notes (not just the one CVE range) for newer security releases beyond that version -- a single npm view/gh api release-notes fetch can surface a later advisory that gets silently skipped if you stop reading after finding the version that satisfies the original alert.

decisions.notes: 2026-07-22: fixed @hono/node-server to 2.0.5 (satisfies the path-traversal alert's first_patched_version), but the same release-notes fetch I ran to check for breaking changes ALSO showed a v2.0.10 entry titled 'Security fixes... WebSocket handshake memory-leak DoS' -- and I didn't act on it, only noticing 3 new Dependabot alerts (77-79) after pushing. Caught and fixed same session, but the miss was avoidable: the information was already in front of me.
